current_problem: Decomposition quality and overhead cannot be compared safely across architecture changes from the existing small historical benchmark set.
proposed_change: Create frozen representative specification/repository cohorts and replayable end-to-end evaluations for correctness, maintainability, cost, latency, routing, context, recovery, and Oracle escapes.
acceptance_evidence: Versioned benchmark manifests and reproducible baseline reports for every cohort
primary_metric: First-pass Luna success plus defect escapes plus total cost

current_problem: The fixed worker protocol and launcher prompt consume substantial Luna attention and expose transaction mechanics to the model.
proposed_change: Generate leaf-type-specific prompts and move claim, heartbeat, fingerprint, validation capture, commit, impact-envelope copying, and result publication into a deterministic worker runner.
acceptance_evidence: Protocol-token reduction with unchanged scope, Git, architecture, and evidence conformance
primary_metric: Fixed prompt tokens and worker protocol failure rate

current_problem: Integer complexity declarations and keyword floors do not prove semantic atomicity or split conservation.
proposed_change: Extend normalized IR with behavior, failure, state, ownership, concurrency, artifact, and validation facet IDs; derive node counts from allocated facets.
acceptance_evidence: Property tests prove child facet union equals parent facets and Luna nodes satisfy typed fan-in rules

current_problem: A planner prompt asks whether validation failures could require edits outside allowed scope, but the property is not generally machine-checked.
proposed_change: Use repository/build/architecture graphs to calculate producer, consumer, representation, test, and build repair seams; require explicit ownership or prerequisite nodes for each seam.
acceptance_evidence: Analyzer rejects known scope-incomplete fixtures and explains the missing seam
primary_metric: SCOPE_INCOMPLETE rate and remediation scope expansions

current_problem: TSV, Markdown, and key/value contracts plus validators are repeated across large shell scripts and prompts.
proposed_change: Define canonical typed schemas and generate parsers, serializers, templates, migrations, and diagnostics while retaining human-readable filesystem projections.
acceptance_evidence: Round-trip, compatibility, and migration suites cover every durable artifact version
primary_metric: Schema repair turns and artifact-validation defects

current_problem: The Terra manager adds a late decomposition layer after the Sol DAG is accepted.
proposed_change: Generate a default node acceptance criterion from DAG evidence; require typed ordered evidence slices when a node legitimately needs several criteria.
acceptance_evidence: Published roots require no semantic criterion transcription for single-boundary nodes
primary_metric: Manager publication retries and criterion drift findings

current_problem: Repository Context Closure is optional and evidence-class recall is not yet an admission requirement for most Luna leaves.
proposed_change: Run advisory cohorts, measure path and evidence-class recall and false blocks, then promote qualified leaf cohorts to required admission.
acceptance_evidence: Promotion reports pass minimum sample, recall, success, and false-block thresholds
primary_metric: CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE rate and closure file/evidence recall

current_problem: Current accepted-success tokens-per-score calibration is model-wide and does not condition on leaf type, language, validation, context, or source-change status.
proposed_change: Build confidence-aware models for tokens, actions, files, duration, and first-pass completion by cohort with conservative shrinkage for sparse data.
acceptance_evidence: Offline replay improves tail prediction without increasing admitted-leaf failures
primary_metric: Actual/effective p95 error and first-pass success by cohort

current_problem: Final Oracle audit is optional even when obligation or architecture risk is high.
proposed_change: Define prototype, standard, and high-assurance profiles with risk-based Oracle requirements and deterministic sampling for low-risk cohorts.
acceptance_evidence: Profile policy is versioned and high-assurance projects cannot complete without required audit
primary_metric: Oracle escape rate and audit cost per obligation

current_problem: Logical state is distributed across many marker, ledger, and directory-presence conventions.
proposed_change: Add a versioned append-only event schema and deterministic reducer; keep current files as compatible projections and recovery aids.
acceptance_evidence: Crash-point replay produces one valid state for every transaction boundary
primary_metric: Invalid state combinations and recovery defects

current_problem: Core state, publication, worker, and architecture logic is concentrated in several thousand-line shell files.
proposed_change: Extract schema, graph, state, evidence, worker, manager, and architecture modules behind compatibility-tested CLIs.
acceptance_evidence: Existing regression suites and benchmark replays pass through compatibility entry points
primary_metric: Change fan-out and regression rate per orchestrator change

current_problem: Strong separation of roles can cause scaffolding cost to dominate bounded implementation.
proposed_change: Cache digest-addressed semantic capsules, generate mechanical fields, and use deterministic or cheaper checks before invoking Terra semantic review.
acceptance_evidence: Equivalent acceptance decisions with lower scaffolding tokens and latency
primary_metric: Scaffolding tokens and dollars per verified item

current_problem: The scheduler serializes all nodes even when the DAG contains independent branches.
proposed_change: Add per-leaf Git worktrees and builds, disjoint mutation admission, producer artifact publication, integration ownership, deterministic merge order, and post-merge gates.
acceptance_evidence: Parallel cohorts reduce critical-path time without higher conflict, rework, gate failure, or defect escape

current_problem: Typed worker failures are recorded but do not yet drive a unified empirically evaluated split/context/scope policy.
proposed_change: Map each typed outcome to deterministic graph transformations or bounded planner patches and evaluate them by later accepted evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Replay fixtures show correct distinct handling of task, context, scope, validation, and resource failures
primary_metric: Replans producing verified gain before escalation

current_problem: Repeated feature work can increase repository search breadth and context requirements even when each leaf passes.
proposed_change: Run periodic reasoning-index scorecards and trigger focused architecture rebuilds using change fan-out, search breadth, context, coupling, and regression evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Before/after scorecards and fresh-agent benchmark improve without behavioral regression
primary_metric: Context bytes, search breadth, fan-out, and ownership ambiguity
